import math, numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im22 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0022.png'))
# Print RGB around each leg in obs22:

# Leg 1: u around 195
# Leg 2: u around 228
# Leg 3: u around 257
# Leg 4: u around 290
print("Floor color around table:", im22[400, 200])

    # scan downwards from v=300 to find where color transitions to floor
    for v in range(300, 420):
        # difference from floor
        diff = np.linalg.norm(im22[v, u].astype(float) - np.array([150, 143, 128]))
        if diff < 20: # matches floor
            print(f"Leg at u={u} reaches floor at v={v-1}")
            break
